about.title: About
about.subtitle: Information about the Gardarr project
about.tagline: Lightweight open-source tool for qBittorrent management and analytics
about.objective: Modern, lightweight management and analytics platform for qBittorrent. Monitor and control multiple clients with a mobile-first interface.

description.title: About the Project
description.text1: Gardarr is a modern, lightweight management and analytics tool designed specifically for qBittorrent. Built with a focus on mobile optimization, it provides an intuitive interface for monitoring and managing your torrents from any device.
description.text2: The project is open-source and community-driven, prioritizing clean, maintainable code that can be self-hosted by anyone. Whether you're managing a single instance or multiple workers, Gardarr offers the tools you need in a beautiful, responsive interface.

features.title: Key Features
features.multiPlatform: Multi-platform support with Docker images for AMD64 and ARM64
features.automated: Automated CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
